Surya Chandra Paper Mills Limited,” the words “M/s.Surya Chandra Paper Mills Private Limited,” shall be substituted. [F.No. 4(3)/2005 - Paper] VANDANA KUMAR, Jt. Secy. Note: The Principal order was published in the Gazette of India vide No. S.O. 1105(E) dated the 11th October, 2004 and subsequently amended vide Order No. S.O. 1690 (E) dated 9th May, 2016.
